questions.question: Where was Jacob buried?
options: In the cave of Machpelah in Canaan
In the royal tombs of the kings of Egypt
questions.answer: In the cave of Machpelah in Canaan

questions.question: What did Joseph tell his fearful brothers about the evil they had done?
options: "I will repay you for all this evil"
"You meant evil, but God meant it for good"
"I can never forgive what you did"
questions.answer: "You meant evil, but God meant it for good"

questions.question: Joseph forgave his brothers and promised to provide for them and their children.
Joseph said, "You meant evil against me, but God meant it for _____."
Before he died, Joseph made the Israelites swear to carry his _____ up out of Egypt.
